en: The front of the postcard features a sepia-toned photograph showing a grand, classical school building with arched windows, accompanied by a large church with a tall clock tower and spire in the background. The lower part of the postcard has the text 'Sundsvall, Läroverket och Kyrkan.' The postcard's reverse side contains handwritten text in Swedish, a postage stamp from Sweden, and is addressed to John Ericson in Alingsås.
